task: Fix Counter in counter.py so concurrent increment calls cannot lose updates. Keep the public increment and value methods.

files.tests/test_counter.py:
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from counter import Counter


def test_counter_thread_safe():
    c = Counter()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        list(pool.map(lambda _: c.increment(), range(4000)))
    assert c.value() == 4000

task: Fix encode_user so datetime values are serialized as ISO-8601 strings and the input mapping is not mutated.

files.tests/test_codec.py:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from codec import encode_user


def test_encode_user_datetime():
    source = {"name": "Ada", "created": datetime(2026, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc)}
    raw = encode_user(source)
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert data["created"] == "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00"
    assert source["created"].year == 2026

task: Fix LRUCache so get marks an entry as most recently used and set evicts the least recently used key when capacity is exceeded.

files.tests/test_lru.py:

def test_lru_recency():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.set("a", 1)
    c.set("b", 2)
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert c.get("b") is None
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    assert c.get("c") == 3
